name: ghost
reason: Large mixed JavaScript and TypeScript monorepo (about 9k files). Scale benchmark for BA-28/BA-17: wall time and peak memory of a full analysis. Budgets are the measured run plus 10% (S1 no-regression rule). Measured 2026-11-03 after the BA-17 memory pass (16-core Windows 11, Bun 1.4.4): 7,174 of 9,171 files analyzed, 328 s wall time, 6,166 MiB peak RSS, 1.6 GB output. Earlier: 768 s and 11,431 MiB after Wave 3; about 26 min in the audit-era run (2026-10-29). Streamed per-file shards (S4) and compact storage (S5) are the next memory and output steps.
